cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both the Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View Menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Modern item availability under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The provided test cases miss test coverage for requirements R-176 and R-177 regarding the visual display of the Classic and Modern themes. Additionally, requirements R-180 and R-181 place items under the View menu which might contradict R-175 if the menu structure is inconsistent, but the primary actionable revision is to add test cases verifying the visual rendering of the themes against the specified images.
confirmed_blockers: Requirements R-176 and R-177 lack corresponding test cases to verify that the Classic and Modern themes display correctly as in the given images.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and cases are well-defined and testable. No blockers were found.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario verifies both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences. Abnormal scenario involving corrupted configuration states is removed per validator feedback. For R-176: Blocked due to missing reference image specified in the requirement. For R-177: Blocked due to missing reference image specified in the requirement. For R-178: Normal scenario verifies 'Theme Preferences' item is available under the View menu. For R-179: Normal scenario verifies 'Get New Themes' item is available under the View menu. For R-180: Normal scenario verifies 'Classic' item is available under the View menu. For R-181: Normal scenario verifies 'Modern' item is available under the View menu.
